title: Large Models for Small Devices: Recent Advances and Empirical Analysis of Edge AI Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2608.15693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Running large AI models on resource-constrained edge devices requires model compression to reduce model size and computation. What compresses well, however, need not deploy well. We survey dozens of recent works that report compression results on real hardware and extract practical deployment guidelines from them. Following these guidelines, we deploy compact language and image models on GPU, CPU, and Raspberry Pi platforms across question answering and image segmentation. No single technique wins across tasks. For question answering, Qwen3.5 0.8B reaches 93.85 SQuAD F1 and 92 EM under Q5_K_M GGUF quantization, while structured pruning at the same precision costs 16 F1 at a 1% ratio. For segmentation, the ranking reverses: default quantization leaves parameters and MACs unchanged, whereas pruning cuts model size by nearly 80% at near-constant mIoU. Pruning can even inflate the deployed artifact by 21-49% by breaking k-quant super-block a

translated_title: 大模型用于小型设备：边缘AI部署的最新进展与实证分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15693v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在资源受限的边缘设备上运行大型AI模型需要模型压缩以减小模型尺寸和计算量。然而，压缩效果好的模型未必部署效果好。我们调研了数十篇在真实硬件上报告压缩结果的最新工作，并从中提取出实用的部署指南。遵循这些指南，我们在GPU、CPU和树莓派平台上部署了紧凑的语言和图像模型，涉及问答和图像分割任务。没有单一技术能在所有任务中胜出。对于问答任务，Qwen3.5 0.8B在Q5_K_M GGUF量化下达到93.85的SQuAD F1和92的EM分数，而相同精度下的结构化剪枝在1%比例下损失16个F1点。对于分割任务，排名反转：默认量化不改变参数和MACs，而剪枝在近乎恒定的mIoU下将模型尺寸削减近80%。剪枝甚至可能通过破坏k-quant超级块结构，使部署后的工件膨胀21-49%。
tldr: 本论文通过实证分析发现，模型压缩技术（如量化和剪枝）在不同任务中的部署效果差异显著，没有单一最优方法，需根据具体任务选择压缩策略。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically reveals that model compression techniques (e.g., quantization and pruning) have task-dependent deployment performance, with no one-size-fits-all solution, requiring task-specific strategy selection.
